Package com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.adapters.in.reconciliation

Class KfeBalanceReconciliationJob

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.adapters.in.reconciliation.KfeBalanceReconciliationJob
@Service @ConditionalOnProperty(name="kfe.balance-reconciliation.enabled", havingValue="true", matchIfMissing=true) public class KfeBalanceReconciliationJob extends Object
Periodically compares custodial ledger values with observations, refreshes watch-only wallets, and reports suspicious locked balances. The job is observational and may request soft probes; it never releases locks or mutates financial balances automatically.

  • Constructor Details

    • KfeBalanceReconciliationJob

      public KfeBalanceReconciliationJob(KfeWalletRepository walletRepository, KfeBalanceRepository balanceRepository, KfeTransactionRepository transactionRepository, org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<KfeOnchainBalanceSyncService> balanceSyncService, org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<KfeColdWalletObservationService> coldObservationService, KfeBalanceMetrics metrics, @Value("${kfe.balance-reconciliation.drift-threshold-sats:1000}") long driftThresholdSats, @Value("${kfe.balance-reconciliation.locked-stuck-minutes:30}") int lockedStuckMinutes, @Value("${kfe.balance-reconciliation.cold-batch-size:20}") int coldBatchSize)
      Creates the reconciliation job and clamps negative/zero thresholds to safe minimums.
      Parameters:
      walletRepository - wallet metadata store
      balanceRepository - balance store
      transactionRepository - transaction status store
      balanceSyncService - optional custodial soft-sync provider
      coldObservationService - optional watch-only observation provider
      metrics - reconciliation metrics sink
      driftThresholdSats - drift threshold in satoshis
      lockedStuckMinutes - age threshold for suspicious locked funds
      coldBatchSize - maximum watch-only wallets examined each run

  • Method Details

    • reconcile

      @Scheduled(fixedDelayString="${kfe.balance-reconciliation.fixed-delay-ms:180000}", initialDelayString="${kfe.balance-reconciliation.initial-delay-ms:90000}") public void reconcile()
      Runs the three independent reconciliation passes, allowing later passes to proceed if one fails. Each failure is logged at the pass boundary and does not cancel future scheduled invocations.

    • checkCustodialDrift

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) protected void checkCustodialDrift()
      Measures absolute differences between custodial available-plus-locked ledger value and observations. Overflows are recorded as maximal drift; values beyond the configured threshold trigger a best-effort balance sync without changing or releasing ledger funds here.

    • refreshStaleColdWallets

      protected void refreshStaleColdWallets()
      Refreshes a bounded prefix of active WATCH_ONLY wallets when an observation adapter is available. Individual wallet failures are isolated so one bad address does not stop the batch.

    • checkLockedStuck

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) protected void checkLockedStuck()
      Reports active internal/custodial wallets whose locks outlive open transactions or have no open transaction. This pass records metrics and logs only; it deliberately leaves financial state untouched.
